detail.longDescription: I have come to accept that although I need to find work or at least get donations in order to survive, and even though I'd rather be teaching or doing research, my true calling on Mastodon is talking shit about LLMs. (And for some reason that one post about socks that did numbers.) To that end: Whenever I see a math paper linked, I check to see if it advertises a chatbot. If it does, I mark the user with an appropriate note and mute them in the hope that seeing my posts might help them rethink their ways. This strategy has been working wonders for my experience of Mastodon. # NoAI # LLM # GetFediHired # MutualAid # AI # chatbot # research # academia # math # mathematics
